title: Geometric stalk sections for descended finite levels
statement: theorem finitePerfectAdic_actual_level_stalk (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶ completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n) (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ) (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale) (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d) (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))))) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Type t) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V.left), Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant V.left T n) (K n)))

proof.text: Restrict the level marking to a geometric point and use the sheafification unit to obtain a local section of the derived Isom presheaf.
